carotid MRA showed carotid arteriosclerosis with limited stenosis of the intracranial left vertebral artery;
The initial diagnosis was transient ischemic attack of the vertebrobasilar system.
response.rationale: Recurrent self-limited dysarthria in a vasculopathic patient with posterior circulation stenosis fits a vertebrobasilar TIA more precisely than the broader label of vertebrobasilar insufficiency, and cerebral vasculitis lacks inflammatory, imaging, or laboratory support.

rejected.why: No evidence of vessel-wall inflammation or other vasculitic features; normal MRI/SWI and unremarkable systemic workup make cerebral vasculitis unlikely.
